seoTitle: Gérard & Fils - International removals across Europe
seoDesc: International removals from Brussels to anywhere in Europe: packing, transport by lorry and end-to-end support from Gérard & Fils.
h1: Your international move anywhere in Europe

sections.h: Gérard & Fils' expertise for your move abroad

body.p: Whether you are planning to settle in France, Italy, Spain or another European country, we plan the services around you so that this change of life goes smoothly. You will reach your destination without any trouble, together with your belongings in perfect condition and within the agreed timeframe.

Has your company posted you abroad and you need to move quickly? Are you leaving Belgium for a well-deserved retirement in southern Europe? Gérard & Fils is your trusted partner for relocating abroad: we plan, organise and carry out every stage of your international move under optimal conditions. We support you with the administrative and logistical procedures so that you can settle into your new country as easily as possible: focus on what matters, and we will take care of the most tedious tasks. Reliability, safety, flexibility, international expertise and professionalism: these are the guarantees of Gérard & Fils!

Far more than a national move, an international move demands careful planning, strict administrative procedures and a thorough knowledge of customs formalities. Our team masters these complex aspects so that you can enjoy this great experience without a worry.
Our removers handle from A to Z:

ul: packing and protection of your belongings
a detailed inventory of everything you are taking with you, if required
full insurance cover for your belongings during transport
advice on choosing the options best suited to your budget and timescale

body.p: We also offer storage space to keep, in optimal conditions and safe from theft and damp, the belongings you cannot take abroad with you. This solution is ideal if you are leaving the country temporarily and want to find your things in perfect condition when you return.

sections.h: Request a quote for your move within Europe

body.p: Would you like a free, personalised quote for your international move within Europe? Contact us by phone or send us your questions via our online form: a detailed reply is guaranteed as quickly as possible.
